## SEO Agent — Admin API (v4.7)
`POST /webhook/seo-site-admin` (header auth: credential **SEO API Key**, header `X-API-Key`). The web app (`app/`) manages tracked sites through it.

Body: `{ action, site_id | domain, ... }` exactly as Site Admin takes it: `pause` / `resume` / `delete`, `cadence` + `pages_per_week`, `unpublish` + `keyword`, `monitors` (+ the monitor fields and `competitors`), `prospect` + `prospect_domain` + `status` / `note`, `ai_prompts` + `add` / `remove`.

Runs Site Admin and **waits** (it takes about a second), then answers `200 { ok, action, site_id, affected, error }`; invalid bodies get **400**, a failing Site Admin **500**.
